flashcard_questions.q: The combination of instruments used in a piece of music.
An effect that clips the audio signal to create a harsh, gritty or fuzzy tone on an electric guitar.
The quality or colour of a sound that distinguishes one instrument or voice from another.

flashcard_questions.a: A vocal technique where a singer produces notes higher than their normal range, creating a lighter, thinner tone.
A studio technique that positions a sound to the left, right or centre of the stereo field.
